content: Hebrew RTL bugs: mixing RTL Hebrew with LTR content (numbers, English) breaks without dir='auto' on inputs and proper directional attributes; string reversal is not a fix; unicode-bidi:bidi-override forces LTR and breaks Hebrew; box-shadow/gradients/icons don't auto-mirror with CSS logical properties; RTL bugs disproportionately appear on mobile and are missed without native-speaker QA.
